wins_1.title: The Shopping List
wins_1.lore: Malgrath wanted to know what I'd seen in the shops on Earth. I told him about the saws. He asked about gold. I told him about a cart that could carry a whole stack of boards without a horse. He asked about gold again. We've made separate lists. Mine is longer, but he says his will pay for it.

wins_3.title: The Spare Chair
wins_3.lore: I made another chair from the offcuts. We'd been passing three round whenever we ate, and someone always ended up on a crate. When I brought it in, the slingers both tried to sit on it. Had to explain it was for one person. They took turns through supper, getting up to check whether the other had had longer. I'll make another when there's spare wood.

wins_5.title: The First Roof
wins_5.lore: We got a roof on one of the village houses. I knew the walls well enough to cut most of the beams before we left the city. Still had to trim two. The gunner said the door used to stick in wet weather, so we took a little off that too. Nobody there to ask us, but it needed doing. I've left the key with him.

wins_10.title: Rain on the Roof
wins_10.lore: It rained while we were at the village. I went inside to check the roof and found a drip by the chimney. Fixed it before supper. The others had brought food, and we ate sitting on the floor because all the chairs were still in the city. Someone asked what I'd do tomorrow. I said there was another house to look at. Slept there that night. Didn't wake until morning.
